newsitem.title: CHINA: China Yunnan 96/97 sugar output at 1.06 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China Yunnan 96/97 sugar output at 1.06 mln tonnes.

text.p: Output of cane sugar in China's southwestern Yunnan province reached a record 1.06 million tonnes in the last pressing season from December 1996 to April 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
That marked an increase of 230,000 tonnes compared with the previous year.

The region expanded the sugar cane-growing area to 160,000 hectares in the last season, increasing the province's sugarcane production to 10 million tonnes from 4.78 million tonnes in seven years, it said.
Daily production capacity of 83 local sugar refineries had climbed in seven years to the current 103,500 tonnes from 58,000 tonnes, it said.
The province has a 14 percent share of the domestic sugar cane market, it said.
